name: Crypto Trading Alerts (BTC/ETH/SOL)
description: Fetches BTC/ETH/SOL price data from Binance, computes RSI/EMA signals, generates an Arabic summary via the Anthropic API, and sends alerts to Telegram.

nodes.name: Fetch Binance OHLCV
nodes.notes: GET klines for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT from Binance public API

nodes.name: Compute RSI/EMA
nodes.notes: Calculates RSI(14) and EMA(9/21) crossover signals per symbol

nodes.name: Filter Signal Events
nodes.notes: Passes through only when RSI crosses 30/70 or EMA9/21 crosses

nodes.name: Generate Arabic Summary
nodes.notes: Sends signal data to Claude, asks for a short Arabic market summary + risk note

nodes.name: Send Telegram Alert
nodes.notes: Posts the Arabic summary to the configured Telegram channel/chat

config_placeholders.binance_api_note: Uses public market-data endpoints only (no API key required for OHLCV)
config_placeholders.anthropic_api_key: SET_IN_CONFIG (never commit real keys — use environment variables)
